subject.character: ONE adult stag; on his branching antlers stands a cozy wooden cabin: smoking chimney, open front doorway; mobile ears; same face throughout
subject.anti_action: weary serious face, brisk dry talker

second_characters: ONE badger driver in the bulldozer cab: vest, visor
props: red ribbon between two birches; yellow bulldozer, words ПОД СНОС on its blade; inside the cabin a mounted stag head trophy with the stag's own face, glass eyes, and a kettle on a hook
environment: sunny edge of a dense forest; a stump next to him; birdhouses on trees; dense background
lighting: bright warm sun behind-left; bright sky glow behind-right, high contrast, bright daylight; at 5.90 sun flashes off the yellow blade; inside: warm sun through log gaps
motion_rule: The camera orbits him in an arc every outdoor beat and changes shot size; trees and leaves slide behind him, never still. The stag moves his whole body in every beat he is in.

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent; first word on frame one; stress: FI-ni-sha, fi-ni-shi-RO-val, go-lo-VA, fsyeg-DA, DO-mye
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once, inside its beat, no speech after 5.9; silent beats: no voice

timeline.a: mouth opens on every syllable; the stag stamps a front hoof, the cabin sways; red leaves sweep past the lens; medium, camera arcs left
mouth opens on every syllable; the stag plods a heavy step and turns; snow sweeps past the lens and piles on the roof; orbit back closer
mouth opens on every syllable; the stag stretches his neck toward a red ribbon across his path, nostrils flared; arc out to medium
mouth opens on every syllable; the stag lunges chest-first through the ribbon, it snaps, a torn end hangs on an antler tine; low arc
mouth opens on every syllable; the stag tilts his antlers down to the stump, face to the lens, and tips the cabin off onto the stump; arc
mouth opens on every syllable; the stag straightens, shakes his antlers and stamps a hoof again, proud; arc around the stump
the stag leaps sideways, ears pinned, as a yellow bulldozer, big words ПОД СНОС on its blade, the badger yanking its lever, rumbles at the stump, blade against it; whipping arc

the camera dives through the cabin's front doorway; inside on the log wall hangs the trophy; the log wall jolts from the blade's shove, the trophy knocks askew on its nail, dust pours down, the kettle swings
camera backs out the doorway; the stag stares at the cabin, eyes wide, ears flattening; the blade presses the stump, engine shaking; short arc
the stag stamps a hoof a third time; the badger honks, grinning; arc
the stag lowers his antlers toward the cabin to lift it back; the blade nudges the cabin, it tilts; low arc
the stag turns to the lens, ears drooping, and snorts; short arc

must_appear: 4.00 the stag tips the cabin onto the stump; 5.90 bulldozer with ПОД СНОС rolls at the stump; 6.60 inside the cabin: mounted stag head trophy on the wall
negative_prompt: small hero, static camera, still background, text except ПОД СНОС on the blade, digits, logos, subtitles, watermark, writing on ribbon, cabin or trees, an inscription or label on the cabin, the kettle or the trophy, trophy blinking or moving its mouth, darkness inside the cabin, walking or running toward camera, side tracking shot, deer running off, a second live deer, duplicate props, floating objects, extra legs, bent antlers, darkness, night, dim light, empty field, a line said twice, foreign accent
